force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Technique
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the light side to enhance your physical abilities, gaining a brief burst of speed or strength.

effects.notes: Advantage on your next Strength or Dexterity check

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Give Life
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You touch a dying creature and stabilize them, preventing them from dying.

effects.notes: Target is stabilized and no longer dying

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Guidance
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You touch one willing creature and grant them divine guidance for a brief moment.

effects.notes: Target gains advantage on their next ability check

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Rebuke
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the light side to rebuke undead or dark side creatures, causing them to flee.

effects.notes: Target must make Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 round

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Spare the Dying
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points and stabilize them.

effects.notes: Target is stabilized and no longer dying

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Valor
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You inspire courage in yourself and nearby allies, granting temporary hit points.

effects.notes: Grant 1d4 temporary hit points to self and nearby allies

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Denounce
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to denounce a creature, causing them to feel doubt and fear.

effects.notes: Target has disadvantage on their next attack roll

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Enfeeble
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to weaken a creature's physical strength.

effects.notes: Target has disadvantage on Strength-based checks and attacks

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Feedback
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to create a feedback loop in a creature's mind, causing them pain.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 psychic damage to target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Lightning Charge
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to create a small electrical charge that can shock a target.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 lightning damage to target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Necrotic Charge
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to create a small necrotic charge that can harm a target.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 necrotic damage to target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Necrotic Touch
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You touch a creature and channel the dark side to drain their life force.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 necrotic damage to target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Psychic Charge
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to create a small psychic charge that can harm a target's mind.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 psychic damage to target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Seethe
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to fuel your own rage and hatred, gaining temporary strength.

effects.notes: Advantage on your next attack roll

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Shock
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the dark side to create a small electrical shock that can stun a target.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 lightning damage to target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Affect Mind
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You subtly influence the thoughts and emotions of a creature within range, making them more receptive to your words and suggestions.

effects.notes: Target must not be hostile toward you

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Battle Insight
force_powers_comprehensive.description: Through the Force, you gain a brief insight into a target's defenses, allowing you to strike with greater precision.

effects.notes: Advantage on next attack against target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Burst
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You cause the earth to burst from beneath your feet, creating a shockwave that affects all creatures around you.

effects.notes: All creatures within 5 feet take 1d4 force damage

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Disarm
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to disarm a creature, causing them to drop a weapon or object they're holding.

effects.notes: Target must make Strength save or drop a held object

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Imbuement
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the Force into a weapon or object, enhancing its effectiveness.

effects.notes: Weapon deals +1 damage for the duration

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Leap
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the Force to enhance your jumping ability, allowing you to leap great distances.

effects.notes: Your jump distance is doubled for this turn

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Push
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You unleash a telekinetic burst, shoving creatures and objects away from you.

effects.notes: Target is pushed 10 feet away from you

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Pull
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to pull a creature or object toward you.

effects.notes: Target is pulled 10 feet toward you

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Shunt
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to quickly move a creature or object to a different position.

effects.notes: Target is moved 10 feet in any direction you choose

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Force Whisper
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to communicate telepathically with a creature within range.

effects.notes: You can communicate telepathically with the target

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Mind Trick
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to influence a creature's mind, making them more likely to comply with your requests.

effects.notes: Target must have Intelligence 6 or higher

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Saber Reflect
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to enhance your lightsaber's ability to deflect incoming attacks.

effects.notes: Gain +2 AC against ranged attacks until your next turn

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Saber Throw
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to throw your lightsaber at a target, then return it to your hand.

effects.notes: Make a ranged attack with your lightsaber

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Saber Ward
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to enhance your lightsaber's defensive capabilities.

effects.notes: Gain +1 AC for the duration

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Slow
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to slow down a creature's movements and reactions.

effects.notes: Target's speed is halved and they have disadvantage on attacks

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Sound Trick
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to create a small sound or noise at a location within range.

effects.notes: Create a small sound at a point within range

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Spirit Blade
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You channel the Force to create a blade of pure energy that you can wield.

effects.notes: Create a melee weapon that deals force damage

force_powers_comprehensive.name: Turbulence
force_powers_comprehensive.description: You use the Force to create a small area of turbulent air that can affect movement.

effects.notes: Create difficult terrain in a 5-foot radius
